title: Chapter 270 Merchant Arrives
content:
Chapter 270 Merchant Arrives

After that, Wang Shuo set the parameters in the dungeon setting interface. In the dungeon, a large number of safe zones were set up. If the player is exhausted, he can enter the safe zone to avoid being attacked.

At the same time, a stone pillar was erected at the entrance of the dungeon to facilitate people entering the dungeon to pay energy crystals.

When the energy crystals paid by the players are consumed, they will automatically exit the dungeon.

Wang Shuo's move is also to hope that more people will upgrade their levels to fight against the upcoming resurrection of the undead.

The next morning, several merchants who had agreed to come to Wana Town came.

Wang Shuo received them in the grocery store.

"Lord Wang, how many dead spirit beads do you have in stock?"

Wang Shuo was shocked when he heard this. They had disdained this thing before, but why did they pay attention to it now?

It turned out that after they went back to promote it, many far-sighted lords took a fancy to this thing!

There are also many lords outside the domain. They already know that the undead army of the Truni Empire is powerful.

After learning that someone was selling the dead spirit beads, they were very excited and ordered a large number of them.

If they hadn't blocked the news, those lords would have sent people to trade in person.

They also knew that the news would be exposed sooner or later, so they wanted to stock up a lot of goods at the first time.

Wang Shuo said slowly: "Now I have 20,000 in stock. I wonder how many you can eat?"

Several merchants looked at each other.

"How about 5,000 for each of the four of us?"

"Okay."

Then, they bought a large number of bronze bricks and left with satisfaction.

In this transaction, Wang Shuo directly earned 350,000 energy crystals.

The dead spirit beads were sold for 200,000 and the bronze bricks for 150,000.

With the growth of population, Yan Fujie quickly expanded the team of masons, and the daily output of bronze bricks has now reached 500,000.

The development of Wana Town is proceeding step by step and in an orderly manner.

The scale of the Red Flame Army is also constantly expanding, and the total number of people has reached 1,500.

Suo Yong, the "Minister of Infrastructure", has been extremely busy during this period. The number of residential buildings needed alone is a huge number.

The corresponding consumption of wood and stone has increased sharply, and the inventory of the territory is not enough.

Duan Wenxi has already opened 5 logging sites and 5 quarries outside.

The entire Wana Town is like a sophisticated machine, running automatically.

Wang Shuo has a rare few days of leisure.

But at this time, other lords in the Dahuai Territory are not idle.

Many lords spontaneously organized and continued to attack nearby towns.

It was like a peasant uprising.

This kind of battle with weak strength and no joint attack.

Naturally, it ended in defeat, and the lords were beaten to a pulp.

After tasting the taste of failure, they began to unite.

It's not that they don't want to unite, but mainly because a small town has only one town heart, and how to distribute it after it is conquered has become the key to their reluctance to unite.

Among them, there is no big boss like Wang Shuo.

As for those who have big bosses, they have already united.

For example, Dongshi Village and Sanyang Village, they have long become overlords and upgraded their third-level villages to small towns.

Seeing more and more small towns being conquered, the remaining lords became more anxious.

After all, there are only so many system towns, and if they are conquered by others, they will be gone.

After a few days of leisure, Wang Shuo received an invitation.
